title: Colosseum 1.1.7
summary: Your own history and stats, your Stremio library and progress, and Trakt through your Stremio account.

highlights.title: Your Colosseum
highlights.body: Highlights from what you read, watched and listened to, recorded by Colosseum on this profile only.

highlights.title: Your own stats
highlights.body: Stats built from Colosseum's own record of your activity, never from outside trackers.

highlights.title: Stremio comes with you
highlights.body: Connect Stremio and your library, progress and watch history come into Colosseum, then keep moving on both sides.

highlights.title: Progress that holds
highlights.body: Watched state follows the order you watched in, long series are handled correctly, and interrupted syncs recover on their own.

highlights.title: Trakt through Stremio
highlights.body: If your Stremio account is linked to Trakt, what you play and pause in Colosseum reaches your Trakt history.

highlights.title: One link, no extra sign-in
highlights.body: Connections shows Trakt via your Stremio account, and Stremio's Trakt add-on is installed for you. Colosseum stores no Trakt token.
